findings.claim: sfcp-q37's deciding facts sit on spring-boot/integration-and-observability/an-integration-test, whose Fast day string is 'An integration test (skim)' (FT8, curriculum/snapshot/pep-calendar.json via its topic.json pointer). The facts are that @DataJpaTest loads only the JPA layer, so there is no BookingService, and that @SpringBootTest supplies MockMvc only with @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Only that page states the second fact as a rule ('@AutoConfigureMockMvc then gives you MockMvc'), and only its table states what @DataJpaTest loads. Two fully taught Fast pages, a-dev-profile-that-keeps-endpoints-open (FT7) and spring-review-layers (FT8), show the annotation pair or choose @DataJpaTest for a query, but neither states the rule, so a Fast learner reaches T3 only by pattern recognition or elimination. The bank's own evidence still says 'Every item's deciding fact sits on a topic taught in full on both tracks, with no exception' (standard-fast-final-checkpoint.md line 40) and 'Module coverage: 19 of the 20 shared modules' (line 47). That reasoning excluded integration-and-observability on purpose. The 45-item expansion (README, coverage-45.json) adds q37 to cover that module without recording an exception. The new-15 education critic rated q37 medium and kept it only on the condition that it is the single skim exception and that Fast learners are told. That condition is not met: the blueprint instructions say the bank covers 'every shared module' but give no Fast note, and the evidence records no owner acceptance. It is not high: the item is a four-case trace that combines two formative facts (an-integration-test/artifact.gift 'o1 mockmvc' and 'o2 choose JPA') rather than repeating either, and the key is correct (T2 and T3; executed earlier on JDK 25 / Boot 4.1.2, sme-findings-new15.json).
findings.recommendation: Pick one, as an owner decision. (a) Keep q37 as the one documented skim exception. Then amend standard-fast-final-checkpoint.md: change the skim rule to name q37 and an-integration-test FT8 '(skim)' as the only exception, give module coverage as 20 of 20 with the reason, and add a coverage-map row for q37. Optionally add one Fast-facing sentence to the blueprint instructions. (b) Replace q37 with an item whose deciding fact sits on a page taught in full on both tracks, for example web-layer-tests-with-mockmvc (FT4: @WebMvcTest as a web slice that needs the service faked) or spring-review-layers (FT8). Accept that integration-and-observability then has no item, as the base 30 recorded. Either way, re-run the key and the cross-final scan for the changed bytes.
